facts.fact: Tilde 在国王宣布时的欣喜是演出来的，Elise 认为她演得太过。
facts.anchor: Tilde had stood as if in ecstatic joy at Liran’s words

facts.fact: Gaisa 只说了一句话，Tilde 脸上就裂开一个近乎癫狂的笑。
facts.anchor: a grin cracked across Tilde’s face

facts.fact: Conrin 与 Gundobar 把 Tilde 带向壁炉，她把手伸进了火里。
facts.anchor: They were leading her towards the fireplace

facts.fact: Elise 当场叫起「女人的舞」，借此把 Tilde 从火边带走。
facts.anchor: ‘Call a woman’s dance,’ she said, releasing Isen.

facts.fact: Elise 用母亲雕成天鹅形状的骨梭卡住暗门，不让 Gaisa 推开。
facts.anchor: Her fingers found her carved bone shuttle

facts.fact: 暗门另一侧与 Gaisa 同行的是 Suneish 女孩 Muirenn。
facts.anchor: It was the Suneish girl, and beside her was Gaisa

facts.fact: Elise 判定 Tilde 中的是血魔法，他们叫它「荣光」。
facts.anchor: ‘It’s old magic. Blood magic. They call it the glory.’

facts.fact: 被问「这会要她的命吗」，Elise 只答了一句「也许」。
